property_summary: For any caller who locks a guess and later calls settle without any adversary (no revert/reentrancy), C either pays out exactly when the revealed blockhash equals the guess (and only then), while the mutant pays out whenever answer is nonzero even when the guess does not match; after settle, a caller can call lockInGuess again (block==0) and non-matching settler loses only their 1 ether stake.
change_summary: Replace the conjunctive payout condition with a disjunction, so a caller is paid if either the answer is non-zero or the stored guess matches.
